arabic text: MAIN KHAAK-E-KARBALA HU, RUTBAA MERA JUDA HAI
english translation text: I AM THE DUST OF KARBALA, MY STATUS IS UNIQUE

arabic text: BINTE ALI (SA) NE MUJHKO CHADAR BANA LIYA HAI,\nMAIN KHAAK-E-KARBALA HUN, RUTBAA MERA JUDA HAI
english translation text: THE DAUGHTER OF ALI (A.S.) HAS MADE ME HER VEIL\nI AM THE DUST OF KARBALA, MY STATUS IS UNIQUE

arabic text: KARTE HAIN RASHK MUJH PAR KAUSAR KE BHI KINAARE,\nZAINAB (SA) KE SAR MEIN MAINE DO SAAL HAI GUZAARE,\nMERA HAR EK ZARRA HAR ZULM KA GAWAAH HAI,
english translation text: EVEN THE FOUNTAIN OF KAUTHAR IS IN AWE OF ME\nAS I HAVE SPENT TIME WITH ZAINAB DURING HER TIMES OF HARDSHIP\nEVERY GRAIN OF ME HAS WITNESSED ALL SORTS OF OPPRESSION

arabic text: AKBAR (AS) JAWAAN QASIM (AS) GHAZII (AS) SE CHAAND TAARE,\nZAINUL IMAAN MERI AAGOSH MEIN UTAARE,\nYAANI LAHOO NABI KA MUJH MEIN MILA HUA HAI,
english translation text: IMAM ZAIN UL ABEDIN HAS BURIED STARS LIKE AKBER(A.S), QASIM(A.S) AND HAZRAT ABBAS (A.S) IN ME\nTHIS MEANS THAT THE BLOOD OF THE PROPHET (S.A) IS A PART OF ME

arabic text: ROTI HU YAAD KAR KE WOH BEKASI KA MANZAR\nMAULA (AS) CHHUPA RHE THE MUJH MEIN WOH LAASHE ASGAR (AS)\nUSS DIN SE AAJ TAK NA MUJHKO SUKOON MILA HAI
english translation text: I CRY REMEMBERING THE MOMENT OF HELPLESSNESS\nWHEN IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) WAS BURYING ASGHER (A.S) IN ME\nFROM THAT DAY I HAVE NOT FELT ANY PEACE

arabic text: SHOHDAA-E-KARBALA KE ZAKHMO'N KO MAINE CHOOMA,\nZEHRA (SA) KI BETIYO'N KE KADMO KO MAINE CHOOMA,\nISS WAASTE HI MERI TAASEER MEIN SHIFA HAI,
english translation text: I HAVE KISSED THE WOUNDS OF THE MARTYRS OF KARBALA\nI HAVE KISSED THE FEET OF THE DAUGHTER OF HAZRAT ZAHRA (S.A)\nTHIS IS WHY I HAVE THE ABILITY TO CURE

arabic text: AKBAR (AS) KI LAASH PAR JAB SHABBIR (AS) JAA RHE THE,\nUTHTE THE BAITHTE THE AUR LADHKHADA RHE THE,\nMANZAR WOH ABH BHI MERI AANKHON MEIN PHIR RHA HAI
english translation text: WHEN IMAM HUSSAIN WAS GOING TOWARDS THE BODY ALI AKBER (A.S)\nHE SAT DOWN, HE GOT UP, HE STAGGERED TOWARDS THE BODY\nTHAT PAINFUL SCENE IS ALSO IN FRONT OF MY EYES

arabic text: QURAAN FATEMA (SA) KA BIKHRA HUA HAI MUJHPAR\nNAA JAANE KIS JAGAH PAR KISKA LAHOO GIRA HAI\nAYE ZAAEREEN-E-MAULA CHALNA YAHAN SAMBHAL KAR,
english translation text: O PILGRIMS OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) TAKE YOUR STEPS CAREFULLY\nTHE CHILDREN OF HAZRAT FATIMA (S.A) ARE SCATTERED ALL OVER ME\nWHO KNOWS WHERE WHOSE BLOOD HAS BEEN SHED

arabic text: TAUQEER TU BHI KARLE AALE ABA KA MATAM,\nJO SHAAM MEIN GAYI THI USS BERIDA KA MATAM,\nMAMNOON MAATAMI KI MAKHDOOM FATEMA (SA) HAI
english translation text: O POET! YOU ALSO DO THE MATAM OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S)\nTHE MATAM OF THE ONE WHO WENT TO SHAAM WITHOUT HER VEIL\nBIBI FATIMA (S.A) WILL APPRECIATE YOUR MATAM
